full_judgment:
Nazmun Ara Sultana, J. This Criminal Petition for Leave to Appeal is directed against the judgment and order dated 28.02.2011 passed by the High Court Division in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 111 of 2011 granting bail to accused-respondent Md. Anower Hossain in Sessions Case No. 98 of 2010 under sections 279/304 (Kha)/427 of the penal Code now pending in the court of Sessions Judge, Manikgonj. 

 4. We, in agreement with the learned Deputy Attorney General, find that the High Court Division was not justified in granting to the accused-respondent in the facts and circumstances of the case. Hence, we set aside the impugned judgment and order granting bail to the accused-respondent Md. Anower Hossain.
